datetime.description: ISO date or date-time. Invalid or missing dates have no time label.

details-label.description: Label of the details control when the details slot is populated.

icon-name.description: Decorative Lucide icon name, registered by the caller's per-icon import.

tone.description:
Marker tone. The event text carries the meaning. Without an icon, a
non-neutral tone draws a solid dot in its ink.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-layout-spacing-md.description: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xs.description: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xxs.description: The xxs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-timeline-dot-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter behind a timeline marker, off by default.

--ki-timeline-dot-bg.description: Fill of the neutral timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-bg-image.description: Optional decorative image over the timeline marker fill.

--ki-timeline-dot-danger-bg.description: Fill of the danger timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-danger-fg.description: Glyph color on the danger timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-fg.description: Glyph color on the neutral timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-icon-size.description: Size of the decorative glyph inside the timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-primary-bg.description: Fill of the primary timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-primary-fg.description: Glyph color on the primary timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-radius.description: Round corners of the timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-success-bg.description: Fill of the success timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-success-fg.description: Glyph color on the success timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-warning-bg.description: Fill of the warning timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-dot-warning-fg.description: Glyph color on the warning timeline marker.

--ki-timeline-gap.description: Space between marker and text and between timeline entries.

--ki-timeline-item-fg.description: Text color of the event summary and details.

--ki-timeline-line-width.description: Hairline width of the timeline connector.

--ki-timeline-time-bg.description: The timestamp shows the surrounding surface through its transparent background.

--ki-timeline-time-fg.description: Text color of the timeline timestamp.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-line-height-para.description: semantic dimension for typography line height para.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

component.description: One event in a timeline, with an optional time and details disclosure.

content.description: Event summary, time and disclosure container.

time.description: Native time element for a valid ISO date.

datetime.description: ISO date or date-time. Invalid or missing dates have no time label.

detailsLabel.description: Label of the details control when the details slot is populated.

iconName.description: Decorative Lucide icon name, registered by the caller's per-icon import.

tone.description:
Marker tone. The event text carries the meaning. Without an icon, a
non-neutral tone draws a solid dot in its ink.

slots.description: Event summary. Include important status information in the text.

details.description: Additional event information in a native details disclosure.

start.description: Decorative avatar or other noninteractive marker in place of the icon.
